objective: Owner request 2026-10-02 12:45 UTC: use real-time prediction-market odds (Polymarket/Kalshi) for decisions, factors or strategies and iterate. First mechanism tested: prediction-market-implied uncertainty about scheduled macro releases (CPI, payrolls, GDP, PCE; FOMC reported separately) as the conditioning variable for the equity macro-announcement premium; second, conditional on free consensus data, the Kalshi-minus-consensus expectation gap as a predictor of the release reaction. Plus an hourly point-in-time forward collector that runs regardless of the backtest result.
target_regime_and_horizon: Event horizon: one session (T-1 close to T close, and T-1 close to T open). Samples: full Kalshi history (first valid event in 2021-09/2022 .. 2026-09-17) and the anchor window 2024-01-08 .. 2026-09-17. There is no pre-2021 stress window because the data do not exist; the literature (Ai/Bansal/Guo 2023 Table 1, 1961-2023) is the long-run prior. Applicable regime: periods of elevated macro and policy uncertainty, as in 2022-2026 (Jan 2020 - Aug 2023 premium 16.33 bp per announcement vs 10.68 bp long-run). Failure signal: rolling 24-event D turns negative.
existing_solution_comparison: Published: the announcement premium itself (Savor-Wilson 2013; Ai-Bansal-Guo NBER w31923, 1961-2023: 10.68 bp/day on announcement days, t 5.36, vs 0.93 bp; non-FOMC 8.65 bp, t 3.71) and option- or variance-based predictors of FOMC announcement returns (Hu-Pan-Wang-Zhu JFE 2022; Jacobs-Ke-Pan 2022; Liu-Tang-Zhou 2022, R2 7.51%; Gafka-Savor-Wilson 2021 realized variance). Missing: release-specific uncertainty for non-FOMC releases (payrolls, CPI, GDP) for which no options exist; FEDS 2026-010 (Diercks-Katz-Wright) shows Kalshi supplies exactly these distributions, well-behaved and news-responsive, but tests forecasting accuracy, not asset returns. Reused, not rebuilt: WillBtK/macro_kalshi (MIT) distribution construction (middle-out monotone cleaning of threshold markets). No public product or replication links Kalshi/Polymarket-implied release uncertainty to the announcement premium (searched 2026-10-02, see queries).
remaining_evidence_gap: Unknown before this step: (1) whether the announcement premium exists in 2021-2026 for CPI/payrolls/GDP days on QQQ/SPY/IWM (the FOMC drift was already refuted locally); (2) whether Kalshi-implied variance measures uncertainty rather than illiquidity of tail strikes; (3) whether the premium scales with it; (4) whether a free point-in-time consensus history exists for H2.
negative_experiments_checked: dir:prediction_market_crypto_as_equity_signal (evidence_too_weak 2026-09-23; generic odds-to-equity lead-lag; this iteration does not reopen it, the mechanism here is risk compensation for scheduled uncertainty, not lead-lag). dir:pre_fomc_announcement_drift (refuted, H-20260928-05: FOMC_DRIFT_SPY anchor Sharpe -0.84, FOMC_DRIFT_TQQQ 0.31): FOMC days are reported separately and excluded from the primary statistic. dir:crypto_weekend_to_monday_equity_transmission (refuted 2026-09-29: priced in the gap) -- shows that information available before the fill tends to be in the open; hence R_co is reported next to R_cc. Amburgey arXiv 2504.02731: sector stocks react to election-odds shocks contemporaneously, not with a lag (supports not testing lead-lag here). ForesightFlow arXiv 2605.00493: documented insider cases are deadline-resolved markets with no link to traded assets (out of scope).
cost_and_execution_assumptions: MOC entry at T-1 (signal known by 15:00 ET, before the 15:50 ET MOC cutoff), exit MOC at T (R_cc) or MOO at T (R_co). Costs per side: QQQ/SPY/TLT 2 bp, IWM 3 bp, TQQQ 5 bp; stress = double. TLT short borrow 0.5%/yr pro rata (easy to borrow). Long-only QQQ/SPY/IWM/TQQQ need no borrow. Invested on about 6-10% of sessions, so it is judged as a program overlay at 0.25x (0.5x if Reg T allows) equity notional, not as a standalone sleeve.
stop_condition: H1 continues only if D = mean(QQQ R_cc | U_rel>1) - mean(QQQ R_cc | U_rel<=1) on non-FOMC release days is >= +15 bp with permutation p <= 0.10 (1000 within-series shuffles, seed 20261002) in the full sample and > 0 in the anchor sample. D < +5 bp or wrong-signed in the full sample: H1 refuted, candidates not scored for adoption. H2 runs only if a free point-in-time consensus history passes feasibility; otherwise blocked_data.

sources.claim: Kalshi distributions for FOMC, CPI, core CPI, PCE, unemployment, payrolls, GDP, recession are well-behaved and respond sharply to news; variance of the fed funds distribution falls after data releases (2022-2025); Kalshi mode matched every FOMC decision on the day before since 2022 (significantly better than fed funds futures); headline CPI forecasts significantly better than the Bloomberg consensus; core CPI and unemployment similar to consensus. No asset-return test.

1961-2023: 10.68 bp/day excess return on announcement days (FOMC, payrolls, GDP, ISM, earlier of CPI/PPI; t 5.36) vs 0.93 bp otherwise; FOMC 17.61 bp, non-FOMC 8.65 bp (t 3.71); Jan 2020-Aug 2023 16.33 bp per announcement; FOMC premium low 2016-2019 (Kurov-Wolfe-Gilbert 2021). Reviews evidence that pre-announcement uncertainty (Hu-Pan-Wang-Zhu 2022), option-implied volatility (Jacobs-Ke-Pan 2022; Liu-Tang-Zhou 2022 R2 7.51%) and realized variance (Gafka-Savor-Wilson 2021) predict announcement returns; counter-evidence Zhang-Zhao 2022 (premium low when information uncertainty is high).

MIT-licensed fork of the FEDS replication package: Kalshi series KXFED, KXCPIYOY, KXCPICOREYOY, KXCPI, KXACPI, KXU3, KXGDP, KXGDPYEAR, KXPAYROLLS; public candlesticks; middle-out no-arbitrage cleaning of threshold CDFs; consensus data not included.
High-frequency election-probability shocks move energy, defense and clean-energy stocks contemporaneously; no measurable lag (evidence against odds-to-equity lead-lag).
Complete on-chain Polymarket CTF Exchange trades 2022-11-21..2026-04-28, 1.20B trades, 1.30M markets, CC BY-SA 4.0, HuggingFace TimeSeventeen/Polymarket-v1 (data source for later Polymarket steps).

cheapest_decisive_test.action: After the manifest is frozen and pre-backtest validation passes: one script computes U_rel per event from Kalshi hourly candles (signal candle ending <= 15:00 ET on T-1), joins SIP daily QQQ/SPY/IWM/TLT returns, and writes the H0 table, the H1 statistic D with a 1000-shuffle permutation p, the T+1 and random-session placebos, and the 9 candidates' per-event stats.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: D >= +15 bp, permutation p <= 0.10 in the full sample, and D > 0 in the anchor sample (QQQ, R_cc, non-FOMC release days).
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: D < +5 bp or wrong-signed in the full sample: H1 refuted; the registry gets a new row dir:prediction_market_macro_release_uncertainty_premium marked refuted with the numbers.
